identity: A form task asks the user to choose specific options using controls such as lists, search fields, switches, and rating grids.

scenarios.name: dropdown
scenarios.screen: A labeled selection field is closed and shows no chosen option. Its menu contains about 5–15 options when opened.
scenarios.scene: The option menu is open, with no option chosen.
never: A permanently visible list of every option beside the field.
Checkboxes inside the option menu.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the selection field.
The label sits to the left of the selection field.

scenarios.hint: Show the labeled dropdown open with the exact requested option among plausible distractors, not selected.

scenarios.name: radio
scenarios.screen: A labeled group shows about 3–6 radio options, with no option selected. Shipping options can also show a price and delivery time beside each choice.
never: A menu that must be opened to see the options.
More than one selected radio in the same group.
A search field for the options.

arrangements.text: The group label sits above a vertical list of radio options.
The group label sits to the left of a horizontal row of radio options.

scenarios.hint: Show the exact requested radio option and several alternatives, all unselected, under the requested group label.

scenarios.name: checkbox
scenarios.screen: A labeled group shows about 4–10 checkboxes. The normal start has no requested options checked.
never: A popup hiding the checkboxes.
Radio buttons that limit the group to one choice.
Chips representing the checked options.

arrangements.text: The group label sits above one vertical column of checkboxes.
The group label sits above a dense grid of checkboxes in three to five columns.

scenarios.hint: Show all exact requested labels plus plausible distractors, initially unchecked; checkboxes must be independent.

scenarios.name: autocomplete
scenarios.screen: A labeled text field is empty, and its suggestion list is closed. Typing into the field brings up matching suggestions from a larger set of names, places, or languages.
scenarios.scene: The field contains a typed query and its suggestion list is open, with nothing selected.
never: A full datasource displayed as a permanent list.
A committed choice shown before a suggestion is selected.
Checkboxes beside the suggestions.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the text field, and suggestions appear directly beneath the field when open.
The label sits to the left of the text field, and suggestions appear beneath the field when open.

scenarios.hint: Show the named text field with partial typed query and a visible suggestion list including the exact target; Sa...ego means San Diego. No committed selection.

scenarios.name: listbox
scenarios.screen: A labeled, fixed-height list shows only several rows at once from about 15–30 items. A scrollbar gives access to the remaining rows; the list can allow one choice or several.
never: All items spread outside the scrolling list.
A popup that must be opened before the rows appear.
Group headers among the rows.
A search field above the rows.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the scrollable list, with its scrollbar along the list’s right edge.
The label sits to the left of the scrollable list, with its scrollbar along the list’s right edge.

scenarios.name: grouped
scenarios.screen: A labeled selection field is closed and has no chosen option. Its popup contains a long scrolling list organized under group headings, including unavailable options.
scenarios.scene: The grouped popup is open, with no option chosen.
never: Group headings displayed as separate selection fields.
Unavailable options shown as selected choices.
The entire long option list permanently visible beside the field.
A search field inside the popup.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the selection field, and the grouped list opens below it.
The label sits to the left of the selection field, and the grouped list opens below it.

scenarios.name: combobox
scenarios.screen: A labeled selection field is closed and has no chosen product. Opening it reveals a search box and a list drawn from about 18–35 product names.
scenarios.scene: The selection list is open with its search box empty and no product chosen.
never: The search box visible while the selection list is closed.
Checkboxes for selecting several products.
A permanent product list beside the closed field.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the selection field; when open, the search box sits above the option list.
The label sits to the left of the selection field; when open, the search box sits above the option list.

scenarios.name: chips
scenarios.screen: A labeled multi-select field starts without chosen chips, and its option list is closed. Chosen options appear as removable chips inside the field.
never: A separate chip tray away from the selection field.
A text search box for filtering options.
An option list permanently open beside the field.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the chip field, and its option list opens beneath it.
The label sits to the left of the chip field, and its option list opens beneath it.

scenarios.name: tags
scenarios.screen: A labeled tag field contains an empty text input and no chosen chips. Matching suggestions appear after text is entered; chosen tags become removable chips before the input.
never: A full tag list permanently visible.
A '+N more' chip when no tags have been chosen.
Checkboxes beside tag suggestions.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the tag field, with chips before the input and suggestions beneath the field.
The label sits to the left of the tag field, with chips before the input and suggestions beneath the field.

scenarios.name: toggles
scenarios.screen: A settings list shows about 5–8 labeled switches in their starting on or off states. Some rows include a short description, and some labels describe disabling or hiding a feature.
never: A popup containing the settings.
One switch controlling the entire list.
A search field for settings.

arrangements.text: Settings run down the page, with each label on the left and its switch on the right.
Settings run down the page, with each switch on the left and its label and description to the right.

scenarios.name: tree
scenarios.screen: One or two named groups each contain a parent control and several child checkboxes. The parent shows whether none, some, or all children are checked; another form uses Select all and Clear links for each group.
never: Children displayed without their group.
A separate popup for each child.
Radio buttons in place of child checkboxes.

arrangements.text: Groups stack vertically, with each parent above an indented column of child checkboxes.
Groups stack vertically, with Select all and Clear beside each group name and the children underneath.

scenarios.name: dependent
scenarios.screen: Two labeled selection fields ask for Country and City. Country has no choice yet, and City is disabled until a country is chosen.
never: An enabled City field before a country is chosen.
Every country’s cities displayed at once.
A third location selection field.

arrangements.text: Country sits above City, with each label above its selection field.
Country sits to the left of City, with each label above its selection field.

scenarios.name: matrix
scenarios.screen: A rating grid has about 3–5 statement rows and a column for each response on a shared scale. Each row offers one radio choice per column.
never: A separate dropdown for each statement.
More than one selected rating in the same row.
A popup containing the rating scale.

arrangements.text: Statement labels form the left column, scale labels run across the top, and radio choices fill the grid.
Scale labels run across the top, with the statement column to their left and each row’s radio choices aligned beneath the scale.
